cpmplus.w1storage.menu.desc: Shows how much space the CPM editor uses inside Blockbench and deletes old autosaves
cpmplus.w1storage.title: Clear CPM storage
cpmplus.w1storage.intro: The CPM editor (Embedded Editor) keeps files and autosaves inside Blockbench, in the browser storage. When that space is full, the editor can no longer save.
cpmplus.w1storage.usage: Used by the CPM editor: %s in %s file(s)
cpmplus.w1storage.total: Total used by this site (Blockbench + CPM): %s
cpmplus.w1storage.recovered: Copies recovered after an error: %s file(s), %s (only removed with "Every CPM editor file")
cpmplus.w1storage.leftovers: Forgotten copies of old exports: %s file(s), %s. They are useless: an old editor bug kept a copy of every export here.
cpmplus.w1storage.notUndoable: Deleting cannot be undone. Your .cpmproject and .bbmodel files on disk are not affected.
cpmplus.w1storage.opt.autosaves.desc: Deletes the automatic copies the CPM editor saves every few minutes. From now on the editor keeps only the 3 newest of each project by itself (fewer when the project is big and they do not fit).
cpmplus.w1storage.opt.leftovers: Forgotten copies of old exports (%s file(s), %s)
cpmplus.w1storage.opt.leftovers.desc: Copies an old editor bug kept of every export. No CPM screen can open them.
cpmplus.w1storage.confirmAll.title: Delete every CPM editor file?
cpmplus.w1storage.confirmAll: This deletes copies saved inside Blockbench by the CPM editor. Your .cpmproject and .bbmodel files on disk are not affected.
cpmplus.w1storage.empty: The CPM editor has not stored anything inside Blockbench. There is nothing to clear.
cpmplus.w1storage.disabled: The browser storage is blocked in this Blockbench, so the CPM editor does not store anything here.
cpmplus.w1storage.storageFull: CPM storage full (%s KB). In Blockbench, use CPM+ > Help > Clear CPM storage.
cpmplus.w1storage.storageFull.title: Could not save
cpmplus.w1storage.storageError: Could not write to the CPM storage: %s
cpmplus.w1storage.mountFailed: Could not open "%s" in the CPM editor: the browser's temporary storage is full (file of %s KB).
